title: chromolaena macrantha
intro: Chromolaena macrantha, commonly known as Mexican mint or Jacob's ladder, is a flowering plant in the daisy family that is native to Central and South America. This plant is rich in health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Chromolaena macrantha include its antiseptic, analgesic, and expectorant properties, which make it useful for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
